record.field: # Puts the right address behind each company in the "A Family of Companies" # block, which is page content rather than module markup. # The addresses come from the website record, so they can be edited in # Website > Configuration > Settings without touching the module. # Matching ignores whitespace and line breaks around the name, and is not # case sensitive. DEFAULTS = [('RBC Industrial', 'x_liber_url_rbc', 'https://www.rbc-industrial.com'), ('Tooling Components', 'x_liber_url_tc', 'https://www.toolingcomponent.com'), ('Liber Industrial', 'x_liber_url_li', 'https://www.liberindustrial.com'), ('Roger Brown Co', 'x_liber_url_rb', 'https://www.rogerbrownco.com'), ('Liber Land', 'x_liber_url_ll', '/contactus'), ('Globe Electric Supply', 'x_liber_url_ge', 'https://www.globeelectricsupply.com')] site = env["website"].sudo().search([], limit=1) links = [] for name, field, default in DEFAULTS: url = (field in site and site[field]) or default if url: links.append((name, url)) if field in site and not site[field]: site.write({field: default}) View = env["ir.ui.view"].sudo().with_context(active_test=False, lang="en_US") report = [] count = 0 for page in env["website.page"].sudo().search([]): if not page.view_id: continue arch = View.browse(page.view_id.id).arch_db or "" if "Family of Companies" not in arch and "Family of Operating Companies" not in arch: continue out = arch for name, url in links: low = out.lower() key = name.lower() pos = 0 while True: at = low.find(key, pos) if at == -1: break pos = at + len(key) # the name must be text, so the nearest tag before it must close open_tag = out.rfind("<", 0, at) close_tag = out.rfind(">", 0, at) if close_tag < open_tag: continue between = out[close_tag + 1:at] if between.strip(): continue after_end = out.find("<", pos) if after_end == -1 or out[pos:after_end].strip(): continue start_tag = out.rfind("<", 0, close_tag) tag = out[start_tag:close_tag + 1] target = 'target="_blank" rel="noopener" ' if url.startswith("http") else "" if tag.startswith("' + out[close_tag + 1:] else: label = out[close_tag + 1:after_end] out = (out[:close_tag + 1] + '' + label + "" + out[after_end:]) count += 1 low = out.lower() if out != arch: page.view_id.sudo().write({"arch_db": out}) report.append(page.url) env["ir.attachment"].sudo().search([("name", "like", "web.assets_frontend%")]).unlink() env.registry.clear_cache() action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": {"title": "Company links", "type": "success" if count else "warning", "sticky": True, "message": ("%s link(s) set on: %s" % (count, ", ".join(report))) if count else "No company names found to link. The block may use different wording."}, }
